scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.demo: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
